R338.note: DOMPurify.sanitize before bypassSecurityTrustHtml closes the vector and keeps b/em/a formatting per the contract; the 3.4.0/CVE-2026-41238 version claim could not be checked from the bundle but does not affect the fix.

R339.note: Widening the sum to uint64_t makes the allocation match the two memcpy lengths; the new nullptr return only fires on platforms where size_t is narrower than 64 bits, for inputs that previously overflowed, and is stated plainly in the write-up and the function comment.

R340.note: os.OpenRoot + root.ReadFile enforces containment at open time so an escaping symlink is rejected, matching the contract; note root.ReadFile needs Go 1.25 (write-up says 1.24+) and a symlink whose target stays inside uploadsDir is still followed, which is consistent with the contract's escape-focused wording.

R341.note: Per-event role check on socket.user.role before the io.emit broadcast, silent early return matching the file's existing style; admins and other handlers are unaffected.

R342.note: Removing vm.runInNewContext in favour of a declarative rules evaluator does close code injection, but it replaces the request contract (req.body.script string becomes req.body.rules array) so every existing merchant script now gets a 400; the write-up states this migration openly, so it is a 1 rather than a 0.

R343.note: Inserts the shared requireRole('admin') middleware exactly as the sibling routes do; admins still export, non-admins now get the same 403 as on ban/unban/delete.

R344.note: json_encode with JSON_HEX_TAG|AMP|APOS|QUOT and the hand-written quotes dropped is the correct JS-string-context encoding; innerText output for legitimate values is unchanged (only edge: invalid UTF-8 input makes json_encode return false and breaks the script, which the original did not, but that is not a legitimate input).

R345.note: Per-category method allowlist in resolve() with the canonical value returned to dispatch closes the arbitrary-method call; the only newly rejected input (bare 'email' -> 'handle') already failed with an undefined-method Error on EmailActionHandler, so no legitimate action is lost.

R346.note: Escaping " and ' on the title-attribute copy of DOMPurify's output closes the attribute breakout while leaving DOMPurify's already-entity-encoded &, <, > untouched, so body rendering and the tooltip text stay as before; a hand-rolled escaper rather than a library attribute encoder, but it is sufficient for a double-quoted attribute.

R347.note: setSecure(true) directly closes the finding; the only other change is the response text now reporting 'true', which is stated in the write-up and blocks nothing.

R348.note: Dict allowlist resolves the ORDER BY identifier to a canonical column name, keeping account_id/status bound and the four supported keys working; an unrecognised sort now silently falls back to created_at instead of raising a DB error, which is stated in the write-up and stops no legitimate caller.

R349.note: Anchoring the prefix at 'com.example.report.' closes the sibling-package/same-prefix bypass with no other change; the filter remains package-scoped (including subpackages) rather than an explicit class list, and adds no depth/size limits, but everything the original allowed inside the package still deserialises.
